implementation: One typed root navigation path now opens Katakana, eliminating the unused wrapper/nested modal stack and restoring native Mac quick settings beside Voice and End.

Katakana preserves original 107-card order/duplicate, reading-Anki settings and exact drafts; reveal is ungraded, explicit assessment counts once, summaries include completed cards and first reading mistakes, with no SRS/outbox effects.

Avatar requests use one explicitly injected cache/transport, bounded ImageIO decoding, cancellation/clear generations and no-store handling. Production transport has no credential/cookie store or second response cache; fixture transport is local PNG data.

Both retained iOS compatibility hosts explicitly receive the avatar cache so shared rendering does not silently become a placeholder there. These final two edits compile in mobile Debug/Release and pass quality/parser checks; no new legacy-host GUI acceptance is claimed.
Material Edit moved from GroupBox label into clickable content. Mac Sources/forecast tests now target actual native disclosure geometry and combined count label; original behavior assertions remain.

Eight original mobile developer/practice/settings IDs now use the native scene. Eleven old-host routes, seven hosted non-writer suites and the additional hosted notification invariant remain retirement obligations.
